title: 2026 草图工具栏 / Sketch Toolbar
noteZh: 核对草图、镜向实体、动态镜向实体等中文工具名称。
noteEn: Chinese names for sketch and mirror tools.

title: 2026 镜向实体 / Mirror Entities
noteZh: 先画后镜向及动态镜向的区别；镜向会建立对称关系。
noteEn: Sketch mirroring creates symmetric relations; explains mirror-before/after-sketch workflows.

title: 2026 智能尺寸 / Dimensioning a 2D Sketch
noteZh: 核对智能尺寸及工具>尺寸>智能路径。
noteEn: Smart Dimension command and menu path.

title: 2026 圆弧/圆之间的尺寸 / Dimensions Between Arcs or Circles
noteZh: 圆心定位与圆周定位不同；16mm应是两圆弧中心距。
noteEn: Distinguishes centre and circumference measurement; the slot 16 mm is arc-centre separation.

title: 2026 特征工具栏 / Features Toolbar
noteZh: 核对拉伸凸台/基体、拉伸切除、压缩与解除压缩名称。
noteEn: Chinese names for extrusion and suppression tools.

title: 2026 圆角属性管理器 / Fillet PropertyManager
titleZh: 圆角属性管理器（英文官方页）
noteZh: 核对Manual、Constant Size Fillets及编辑已有圆角行为。
noteEn: Manual mode, constant-size fillets, and editing existing fillets.

title: 2026 质量属性 / Mass Properties
noteZh: 当前路径为工具>评估>质量属性；选项可改变输出单位。
noteEn: Current path Tools > Evaluate > Mass Properties; options can change report units.

title: 2026 显示质量属性 / Displaying Mass Properties
titleZh: 显示质量属性（英文官方页）
noteZh: 计算质量、重新计算和报告设置的英文名称。
noteEn: English commands for calculated mass, recalculation, and report options.

title: 2026 退回控制棒 / Rollback Bar
noteZh: 上下移动控制棒，逐步查看重建过程并编辑特征。
noteEn: Move the bar to inspect regeneration stages and edit features.

title: 2026 从属关系编辑 / Dependency Editing
noteZh: 压缩与解除压缩及父子依赖。

title: 拉伸属性管理器（2025补充参考） / Extrude PropertyManager (2025 supplementary)
noteZh: 核对给定深度、完全贯穿、反向及合并结果名称；此页为2025补充，未冒称2026界面实测。
noteEn: Supplementary names for Blind, Through All, Reverse Direction and Merge result. This is a 2025 reference, not a tested 2026 UI capture.

title: 2026 材料属性与数据库 / Material Properties and Databases
titleZh: 材料对话框 - 属性标签
noteZh: 核对自定义材料数据库位置、材料单位及密度属性。
noteEn: Custom material database locations, material units, and density properties.
